figures.finding: In Tajikistan a minor of fourteen to eighteen makes contracts with his legal representatives' written consent, but without it disposes of his own earnings and exercises his author's rights in his own literary or artistic work; under fourteen only the legal representatives contract for him. No share of earnings is set aside by law.

value.consent: written consent of parents, adopters or guardians
value.reachesWritingDirecting: yes: author's rights in his own work

figures.finding: Under Tajikistan's Labour Code an employment contract may be made from fifteen, and from fourteen, with a parent's consent, with a pupil or student of a general, technical or specialised secondary school.
figures.applies: Tajikistan; the State's report of 2016 on the Labour Code of 2016.

sources.said: Under the Labour Code, a contract of employment (or recruitment) may be signed with persons aged 15 years or older. The Labour Code does allow an employment contract to be signed, with the consent of the parents or persons acting in loco parentis, with persons aged 14 years or over
